question: How is the trident-bearing Lord of Serpents honored in salutation?
premises: Obeisance is offered to the trident-holder.
The same deity is addressed as Lord of Serpents.
The salutation is repeated for reverence.
inference: Nāgeśa is revered as the bearer of the trident.
plain_english: Obeisance to the trident-holder, obeisance, obeisance to Nāgeśa.
